stemMarkdown: Find the remainder when $144 \times 53$ is divided by $11$.
solutionMarkdown: Reduce each factor first: $144 \equiv 1$ and $53 \equiv 9 \pmod{11}$. So the product is $\equiv 1 \times 9 = 9 \equiv 9 \pmod{11}$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Reducing before multiplying keeps the numbers small — the remainder is unaffected.
